entries.title: Kicking off the hub
entries.body:
First entry in the build log.

Setting up a small hub site to share what I'm building with the Book Machine and the other tools alongside the FFA crew. The plan: a home page, an updates/journal feed pulled straight from this Notion database, and a resources section to share build docs like the one for Seedsmith.

More to come as the pieces come together.

entries.title: Why Notion is the source of truth
entries.body:
Decided the journal lives in Notion and the site reads from it.

The flow: I write an entry here, run a quick sync command, and the site picks it up. Only entries marked Published show up publicly, so I can keep drafts private. Keeps everything in one place and lets the site stay simple and free to host.
